finding.rationale: Cross-user inbox-rule and message reads (GET /users/{id}/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules and /messages) require the operator to hold Exchange Administrator or Global Reader; without such a role the surface is limited to the operator's own mailbox. Removing standing assignment of Exchange Administrator / Global Reader and issuing it only just-in-time via Privileged Identity Management denies an adversary the cross-mailbox reach the technique depends on. Recommended-but-not-yet-observed: no committed replay-log sample exercises Tool 13 yet (it shipped after the last committed run).
